questions.question:
Select the option in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers in the given set.

(146, 102, 58)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **(1st number + 3rd number) ÷ 2 = 2nd number**.

Now,

For (146, 102, 58)

⇒ (146 + 58) ÷ 2

⇒ 204 ÷ 2 = 102.

Now, checking the options:

Option 1) (164, 120, 56) 

⇒ (164 + 56) ÷ 2

⇒ 220 ÷ 2 = 110 ≠ 120.

**Option 2) (150, 106, 62)**

**⇒ (150 + 62) ÷ 2**

**⇒ 212 ÷ 2 = 106 = 2nd number.**

Option 3) (168, 114, 70)

⇒ (168 + 70) ÷ 2

⇒ 238 ÷ 2 = 119 ≠ 114.

Option 4) (152, 108, 84)

⇒ (152 + 84) ÷ 2

⇒ 236 ÷ 2 = 118 ≠ 108.

Here, 'Option 2' are related in the same way as are the numbers in the given set.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.

questions.question:
By interchanging the two numbers 20 and 36, which of the following equations will be correct?

I. 55 + 42 – 36 × 20 ÷ 9 = 17

II. 20 ÷ 2 × 36 + 81 – 41 = 400
questions.solution:
BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Given equation I: 55 + 42 – 36 × 20 ÷ 9 = 17

Now, if '20 and 36' are interchanged, then:

⇒ 55 + 42 – 20 × __**36 ÷ 9 **__= 17

⇒ 55 + 42 – __**20**____** × 4**__ = 17

⇒ __**55 + 42**__ – 80 = 17

⇒ __**97 – 80**__ = 17

= 17 = 17.

LHS = RHS.

Given equation II: 20 ÷ 2 × 36 + 81 – 41 = 400

Now, if '20 and 36' are interchanged, then:

⇒ __**36**____** ÷ 2**__ × 20 + 81 – 41 = 400

⇒ __**18**____** × 20**__ + 81 – 41 = 400

⇒ __**360**____** + 81**__ – 41 = 400

⇒ __441 – 41__ = 400

= 400 = 400

LHS = RHS.

Here, Both I and II are correct equation after interchanging the given symbol.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".

questions.question:
Which of the numbers (not digits) should be interchanged in the given equation to make it mathematically correct?

4 + 6 × 3 − 5 ÷ 2 = 16
questions.solution:
Given equation: 4 + 6 × 3 − 5 ÷ 2 = 16.

BODMAS Table: 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d50192f098c21078501d30eeafe1a8c64bc30dd9621c48caa8a39ffc60f68b64.png] 

Let's check each option one by one.

Option 1) 5 and 6

Given: 4 + 6 × 3 − 5 ÷ 2 = 16.

After interchanging the Numbers we get;

⇒ 4 + 5 × 3 − __**6 ÷ 2**__ = 16

⇒ 4 + __**5 × 3**__ − 3 = 16

⇒ __**4 + 15**__ − 3 = 16

⇒ __19 - 3__ = 16

⇒ **16 = 16**

⇒** LHS = RHS**

Option 2) 4 and 6

Given: 4 + 6 × 3 − 5 ÷ 2 = 16

After interchanging the Numbers we get;

⇒ 6 + 4 × 3 − __**5 ÷ 2**__ = 16

⇒ 6 + __**4 × 3**__ − 2.5 = 16

⇒ __**6**____** + 12**__ − 2.5 = 16

⇒ __**18 − 2.5**__ = 16

⇒ 15.5 ≠ 16

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS.

Option 3) 2 and 3

Given: 4 + 6 × 3 − 5 ÷ 2 = 16

After interchanging the Numbers we get;

⇒ 4 + 6 × 2 − __**5 ÷ 3**__ = 16

⇒ 4 + __**6 × 2**__ − 1.66 = 16

⇒ __**4 + 12**__ − 1.66 = 16

⇒ __**16 - 1.66**__ = 16

⇒ 14.34 ≠ 16

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Option 4) 5 and 3

Given: 4 + 6 × 3 − 5 ÷ 2 = 16

After interchanging the Numbers we get;

⇒ 4 + 6 × 5 − __**3 ÷ 2**__ = 16

⇒ 4 + __**6 × 5**__ − 1.5 = 16

⇒ __**4 + 30**__ − 1.5 = 16

⇒ __34** − 1.5 **__= 16

⇒ 32.5 ≠ 58

⇒ LHS ≠ RHS

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question: Among seven friends P, Q, R, S, T, U and V; U is taller than only three other friends. R is tallest among all friends. T is taller than U. Q is taller than only one person. Only two persons are taller than P. V is taller than Q. Who is the shortest among all the friends?
questions.solution:
Given: Seven friends P, Q, R, S, T, U and V. 

R is tallest among all friends.

R > __ > __ > __ > __ > __ > __

Q is taller than only one person.

R > __ > __ > __ > __ > Q > __

U is taller than only three other friends.

Only two persons are taller than P.

R > __ > P > U > __ > Q > __

T is taller than U. 

R > T > P > U > __ > Q > __

V is taller than Q. 

R > T > P > U > V > Q > __

And, S will placed at the remaining place.

So, **"S"** is the shortest among all the friends.

Hence, the correct answer is **"S"**.
